verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs explicitly show social providers (Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, and more) configured declaratively via a plugins/providers array, and the SSO plugin extends this to OIDC, OAuth2, and SAML providers without custom code. Community testimony corroborates this ('Hundreds of auth features like OAuth providers (google, apple, github)... you pay $0', 'various sign-in options... all handled by Better Auth's included plugins and defaults'). Missing for 10: an exhaustive documented list of all supported named providers (docs only name a handful of examples plus 'and more') and independent verification of configuring an obscure/long-tail provider without code.
